description: Base portraits of fictional players and coaches in a plain chroma-key green top on a transparent background. The game recolors the green top into the current team's jersey and adds the crest, so transfers never need new images.
style: Professional esports media-day portrait photograph with a fully transparent background (the person only, cleanly cut out, no backdrop, no floor, no shadow behind). Chest-up framing, subject centered with the top of the head about 8% below the top edge and the shoulders filling the lower part of the frame, shoulders angled slightly, head turned to face the camera, eyes level with the lens. Lighting: large softbox key light from camera left, gentle fill from the right, subtle cool rim light on hair and shoulders. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin texture, photorealistic editorial sports photography. CLOTHING (important): a plain short-sleeve athletic crew-neck shirt in one single flat, saturated chroma-key green color (#00B140), matte fabric with natural folds, absolutely no pattern, no stripes, no trim, no logo, no text, no other colors on the shirt. No green anywhere else in the image (no green eyes, no green jewelry, no green lighting spill). No headset, no props, no hat. The person is entirely fictional and must not resemble any real person or public figure.
coachStyle: CLOTHING (important): a plain chroma-key green (#00B140) zip-neck team training top with the zip closed, one single flat saturated color, no pattern, no logo, no text.
